## Body

PR #153 at 37056e3e0776866578461068ad0d623d6749a6be is security BLOCK S153-001 MEDIUM. http/fyi.rs:233-255,281-393 authenticates the machine and checks requested seat/pane/session against the registry, but correct victim identifiers do not prove reporting-caller ownership. Ordinary local roster access supplies victim panes; forged context can bypass cold-wake auditing or create victim FYIs through reported_context.rs:39-85. Required control: another caller supplies CORRECT victim identifiers and must mutate neither victim activity nor context; legitimate self-report is the positive control. Incorrect-identifier tests fail to prove this boundary. Bind caller independently or require an unforgeable incarnation capability before mutation. Payload notes separately include folder/digest fields beyond the narrow claimed alert contents; do not imply every note is a graded exploit. Source-only review, both exact-head CI attempts green. Verdict: security/outputs/2026-11/07-verdict-pr-153-37056e3.dd.json.
